id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13b6: "Did you hear a strange sound? A loud thud, like something crashing. A vibration.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c0: "I don't want to worry my wife needlessly, so don't tell anyone in the kingdom. It's a secret between me and you, traveler fish.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d2: "I'm not saying I don't trust the Queen, but the magic barrier can't be all-powerful.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13dc: "If an evil monster stronger than the Queen's power targeted the undersea kingdom, I couldn't sleep at night.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f8: "I was hooked by a human once, and since then I'm terribly afraid to swim in the sea.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1405: "Just by biting a plain bait I was yanked up above the sea, unable to breathe or even cry out.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1412: "...And scariest of all was that human's face, fierce as a moray eel! Remembering it, I can't stop shaking...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1424: "A human hooked me once. I thrashed with all my might and slipped free back to the sea.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1436: "When Jarvis attacked I remembered that, thrashed with all my might, slipped between his claws, and escaped his clutches!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1444: "No matter how hopeless, if you never give up and keep struggling, your chance will come!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1453: "Since the Dark One is gone, the sea water has felt softer and my body feels better.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|145d: "We fish struggle to breathe in dirty water, so this is a real relief.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1472: "This is the Deep Sea Court. Every dispute in the undersea kingdom is judged here.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|147d: "An important trial is underway, so if you have no business, please leave.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|148d: "I heard, I heard! You defeated Death Aegir, who was troubling the sea?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1497: "Well, well... You look as meek as a goldfish, yet you're as strong as a shark.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14b6: "Undersea creatures each respect others, recognize individuality, and do jobs and live lives that suit them.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c6: "For example, we sea folk aren't athletic but good with our heads, so some of us, like me, become bankers. Now then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14df: "I only realized after going to the surface that we sea folk could surprisingly live on land.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14ec: "Maybe I'll go train as a bank clerk in some town. Now then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1504: "Ah... it's terrifying even to say... The night a monster attacked the northern sea where I lived. My friends... every one...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1513: "...I don't want to remember more. Anyway, don't go outside the kingdom. This sea is the only safe place in the world.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1526: "After Jarvis attacked the northern sea and I lost all my friends, my heart lay at the bottom of a dark sea.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1535: "But when I heard the Luminary defeated Jarvis, sunlight seemed to shine in my heart. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1548: "Things are terrible on the surface, so I evacuated to Nautica. I think it's safer than surface islands.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1559: "Hey, hey, I heard. You accepted the Queen's request to deal with the sea being ravaged?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1564: "Before I came here I'd heard of Death Aegir ravaging the sea too. They say it's extremely strong... don't die.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1578: "You defeated Death Aegir? The sea should quiet down now, so I can only thank you... thank you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1583: "If the surface turmoil settles too, I could go back to my old home and want for nothing. I'm counting on you, okay?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|159c: "Oh, I haven't seen your face in this kingdom. Then you haven't tried Nautica's famous jet current yet, have you?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15aa: "That's brave! Fish visiting for the first time fear the strong current and can't enter!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15bd: "My, what a waste. Enter this current and you'll shoot to the top of the kingdom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15c7: "Swimming through the sea is tiring, so use this jet current well and enjoy a seabed stroll.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15db: "While fleeing across the seabed I saw something odd.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e2: "Icebergs are normally ice, right? But the northern sea's iceberg was golden, like the Queen's hair.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f4: "Luminary! Luminary! I've been your fan all along! Would you sign my fin?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1600: "...But even if you wrote on my fin, I couldn't see it myself... Damn! What a shame!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1616: "The wordless sea is stirring. It's coming... something's coming... That one's eyes are already on the seabed...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1623: "...The voice of the sea only tells the truth. An evil power may be closing in on this kingdom, bringing rough waves...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1637: "Jarvis fell and the sea's cry has calmed. But the wounds of so many lost lives can't be healed quickly...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1644: "Until the Dark One Mordegon falls and the world is at peace, I will keep listening to the voice of the sea.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1656: "The wordless sea is stirring. The evil one who hunted lives has fallen... the child of light brought peace to the world, it says.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1666: "...The voice of the sea only tells the truth. Let me thank you on behalf of the sea. Thank you, Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1678: "I can tell... The sea... no, this world is now in danger of ruin from evil power...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1683: "The hope of everyone living in this world rests on just one... the Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1699: "Our Queen Seren is the kingdom's idol.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a0: "The pure white scales that mark a queen. Golden shining hair. Beautiful eyes holding kindness and strength.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16ad: "...No one so beautiful exists anywhere in the world but Lady Seren.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16bc: "...We who live in the sea know that things are terrible on the surface now. The sea is affected too...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16cb: "What will become of this world? Fleeing into drink solves nothing, I know, but still...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16dc: "I've heard rumors of Death Aegir. A terrifying monster with immense power that supposedly hates us mermaids...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16ea: "Oh, how terrifying! I can't bear it without a drink...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f5: "They say Death Aegir, who was ravaging the sea, was defeated. Truly, congratulations!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16ff: "A day like this calls for a drink! Today let's let loose and drink up!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|170f: "Hello, ex-human Luminary. Glad to see you well!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1719: "You're an ex-human, aren't you? How does it feel being turned into a fish by the Queen's power?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|172a: "Your body has an unusual color. I've never seen those fins. You're quite stylish and cool.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|173c: "...What? Surprised a fish can talk? Big brother, you're a strange fish. You're chattering too.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|175f: "Welcome~. We carry useful armor, so please take a look~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1768: "...I'd like to say, but lately goods have stopped arriving and I have nothing to sell. Sorry~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|178a: "Welcome~. We carry useful armor, so please take a look~. Well then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ac: "Welcome~. We carry useful armor, so please take a look~. Well then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17cb: "It was decades ago. I was fascinated by the human world then, and often went to watch ships passing near the kingdom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17f7: "It was decades ago. I was fascinated by the human world then, and often went to watch ships passing near the kingdom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17db: "A cheerful singing voice I heard then still rings in my ears. I want to hear that song once more...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1808: "The ship was a fine merchant ship. Among many sailors was a small boy.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1814: "The boy held an instrument in his small hands and sang cheerful songs every day.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1820: "His song had a bright, merry rhythm unheard in the undersea kingdom. I listened, entranced.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|182f: "...But after a while the boy seemed to have left the ship, and the merry song stopped.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|183a: "Ah, I want to hear that song just once more. Traveler, could you find the boy and ask him to sing?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1851: "...Sorry for the unreasonable request. I'll give up my longing for the surface and live quietly on the seabed.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1865: "...Thank you, traveler! It was so long ago that I don't remember much about the boy.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1870: "All I remember is the human writing 'Gondolia' on the ship...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1897: "All I remember is the human writing 'Gondolia' on the ship...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1879: "Please, traveler. Find the boy and ask him to sing that song once more.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a0: "Please, traveler. Find the boy and ask him to sing that song once more.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|188e: "It was so long ago that I don't remember much about the boy who sang.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18c0: "Traveler, welcome back! Did you find the boy? Will he sing that song once more?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18cb:
{var:1} told the mermaid
about the old man and sang
the song he taught.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18d5:
The ship drifts with the waves♪
The open sea we race across the wind
is our home, our mother♪
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18e0:
No matter how far apart we are
if the sea's song rides the breeze to you♪
Our hearts will return to the sea♪
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ed:
Noho ho, noho ho, nohohoo♪
Sing and dance the sea's song♪
Echo and reach our mother♪
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f8: "...Yes, yes, this is the song. The nostalgic longing of a faraway day comes back to me.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1900: "But to think I can't hear his voice anymore. Human lives are so fleeting. Maybe that's why they make such lovely songs.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|190d: "Thank you, traveler. I was glad to hear that song once more. Please take a thank-you gift.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1922: "I can't sing like you or him, but I learned that song. If you like, listen to it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1964: "Oops, don't disturb me. I'm gathering important tribute to deliver to our trade partner, the Queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1973: "Oops, don't disturb me. I'm gathering important tribute to deliver to our trade partner, the Queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1984: "Oops, don't disturb me. I'm gathering important tribute to deliver to our trade partner, the Queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19a1: "I'm a Sniflheim Viking. I'm gathering important tribute to deliver to our trade partner, the Queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ae: "...What, my brother sent you? Aha, he asked you to look for me. That brother of mine is such a worrywart.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19bb: "I got stranded while sailing to find tribute for the Queen, but as you see, I'm fine.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19c8: "And luckily the sea here is a treasure trove of Jumbo urchins, the Queen's tribute.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d6: "So I gathered Jumbo urchins and was about to deliver them to Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e1: "...No, wait. Perfect timing. Could you deliver this tribute to the purveyor in Sniflheim?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ee: "I'll stay here a bit longer to gather more tribute, so don't worry. Sorry for the sudden request, but I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a13: "I'll stay here a bit longer to gather more tribute, so don't worry. Sorry for the sudden request, but I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a08: "Please deliver this Jumbo urchin tribute for the Queen to the purveyor in Sniflheim.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a26: "...You delivered the Jumbo urchin to the purveyor in Sniflheim. Thanks for taking on the sudden request.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a32: "I'll stay here a bit longer to gather more Jumbo urchins, so don't worry.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a59: "Our Nautica National Museum turns six hundred soon. We plan new exhibits for it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a6b: "We plan to exhibit a human tool that will amaze you, so look forward to it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a84: "Our Nautica National Museum will soon mark its six hundredth anniversary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a8f: "To commemorate it, I'd like to exhibit a rare item from the surface.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a97: "It's a human tool I saw on the surface when I was still a spry sea turtle...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa3: "As you see, I'm a sea turtle. Fetching a human tool is very difficult...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aae: "So! I need the power of the legendary Luminary who can move freely between seabed and surface!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aba: "Would you please fetch the human tool to exhibit at the museum?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1acb: "...I see. You must be busy, Luminary. Sorry to detain you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae6: "Oh! How kind! The item I'd like you to find is a mysterious giant octopus pot.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af2: "How many years ago was it. Strolling near a human village, I saw that octopus pot on a cliff.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b00: "It was big enough for a mermaid to fit inside, with a beautiful form. While I was admiring it, the next moment...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0c: "A boom echoed and the water surface churned like a storm! I was so moved I forgot to breathe!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b19: "...Ever since, that octopus pot that booms and fits a mermaid has held my heart!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b26: "If you know of it, please acquire that octopus pot and bring it to the Nautica National Museum.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b5e: "If you know of it, please acquire that octopus pot and bring it to the Nautica National Museum.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b30: "I entrust the six-hundredth anniversary of the National Museum to you, Luminary!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b43: "The only exhibit worthy of the six-hundredth anniversary is that booming octopus pot that a mermaid fits inside!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b50: "Among the people you met living near the sea, someone surely owns that octopus pot.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b6d: "Oh! I've been waiting, Luminary! Did you bring the booming octopus pot a mermaid fits in?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b7d: "...We staff all fully understand it's not easy to obtain.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b87: "However, the six-hundredth anniversary is right before us. ...Please hurry, Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba8: "Oh! This is exactly the giant octopus pot I've sought!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1baf: "...What? This is a human weapon called a cannon? It makes a loud noise when it shoots an iron ball?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bbd: "Ho ho! Humans even make weapons of octopus pots to fight!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bc4: "I'd heard they're a warlike race, but to this extent... Humans are deep creatures.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bd1: "Anyway, thanks to you, we can create the best exhibit fit for the six-hundredth anniversary!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bde: "Well then, it's modest, but a thank-you from the National Museum. Please accept this gift.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf2: "Ah, the human world is truly complex. After decades and centuries of research, there's still so much we don't know.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c00: "That's why research is rewarding. We, the Nautica National Museum staff, will keep tackling the mysteries of the surface.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c2d: "For a rookie lawyer like me, the first job is usually a shark speeding violation or a turtle's napping swim.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c3c: "Of all things, my first case is an assault over whether someone ate someone. It's too heavy for me...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c54: "I may not look it, but I'm a lawyer defending a sea person who nibbled the right flank of a fish friend.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c63: "But I'm the greenest of rookies, so I have no idea how to prove his innocence.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c72: "A casebook by a legendary senior lawyer with countless acquittals would surely help my defense.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c84: "I'd like to borrow the casebook right away, but the trial has already begun. As counsel I can't leave the courtroom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c93: "Luminary, if you don't mind, could you go to the senior lawyer in my place and borrow the casebook?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ca8: "...Sorry for the unreasonable request. You're busy, Luminary. Sigh... what should I do.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cbc: "...Thank you, kind Luminary! The legendary senior lawyer is retired now and left the undersea kingdom long ago.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ccd: "Rumor says they landed on an uninhabited island at the far west and live on land like a human.
